title: the harbor master answers get traffic and show traffic: its traffic image as a status view
intention: harbor_master declares one view, map (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/device.py:58). Its traffic image (voyage.traffic_image, the emergent gates, at anchor, berthed) is reached only by importing voyage, which is how cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py:93 hands it to the web server. harbor_master declares a second view, traffic, the traffic image over its own fleet register, so any device asks get traffic or show traffic over the bus.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-encapsulation-holds naming cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py:93 importing cairn.devices.cairn.machines.harbor_master.voyage so the web server can render /harbor. RULE 1 makes the bus harbor_master's public interface, and outline 9.4.1.5 gives it status queries (show, get); the traffic image is a status the bus does not yet answer.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 9.4.1.5 (harbor_master's verbs are status queries: show, get); outline 17.13.1.
how: In device.py declared_views returns {"map": self._fleet_map, "traffic": self._traffic_view}; _traffic_view returns voyage.traffic_image(self._fleet_map()), imported at call time. New proof cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_the_harbor_answers_get_traffic.py, three teeth.
